title: Speaking — Using parks
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on using parks.

questions: What do you enjoy doing when you have an hour to yourself?
Are your hobbies different from when you were younger?
Do your relatives share any of your interests?
Is there a hobby you would like to learn from someone?
How often do you go to a park?
What facilities would you like in a park near home?

part2.topic: Describe an outdoor space that was improved for local people.
points: what the space used to be like
part2.closing: and explain why the change mattered to you.

questions: How can cities provide green space in crowded areas?
Who should decide how public parks are designed?
How has everyday life connected with using parks changed for people of different ages?
